name: TPI Polene Public Company Limited
summary: TPI Polene Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes cement products and mortar cement under the TPIPL brand in Thailand, China, Bangladesh, Australia, India, the Philippines, and internationally. It operates through Construction Materials, Petrochemical & Chemicals, Energy & Utilities, and Agriculture segments.
